configurations.name: api-docs
runtimeArgs: const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const root=path.resolve('docs');const types={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.yaml':'text/yaml; charset=utf-8'};http.createServer((q,r)=>{let p=decodeURIComponent(new URL(q.url,'http://x').pathname);if(p==='/')p='/api.html';const f=path.join(root,p);if(!f.startsWith(root+path.sep))return r.writeHead(403).end();fs.readFile(f,(e,d)=>{if(e)return r.writeHead(404).end('Not found');r.writeHead(200,{'content-type':types[path.extname(f)]||'application/octet-stream','cache-control':'no-store'});r.end(d)})}).listen(process.env.PORT||4100,'127.0.0.1',()=>console.log('API docs on port '+(process.env.PORT||4100)))
